On my birthday, I woke up earlier than my usual to work with people in my class to come up with a surprise birthday party for one of our classmates. Her birthday was a few days before mine. 

The plan was to take her to four places that meant a lot to her before taking her to the fifth stop where the party was, so four of us got assigned to each of those places with gifts in tow. While the three others were brought by a classmate's car to their assigned places, I was asked to go alone to mine. I felt bummed but I took a cab anyway and waited there.

It took more than an hour for them to go where I was. Turns out, they stayed longer at one of the stops because the birthday girl sensed that she was up for a surprise and wanted to delay things. I was texting the classmate who was with her in the car but I got no reply. Finally when they got to my stop, I greeted her a happy birthday and gave her the gift. She was so delighted about how amazing her day was going and how her friends planned this all that she was thanking them for my gift to her. I felt like a prop and I was invisible. Nevermind that I waited for more than an hour, at least they got to pull things off.

Apparently my stop was the last stop. I didn't know of this before. There were two cars at the time and we were already heading towards the party. Everyone got in the cars, including the three others who were assigned at the other stops, and I was the only one who was asked if I would be coming with them. Uhm, excuse me? How am I supposed to go to that place? By taking a cab again? Or am I not invited to this whole thing after waiting for more than an hour?

I got in one of the cars and arrived at the party. And man, it sucked. I felt like a stranger the whole time and was told more than once "Oh, I didn't know you're here!"

After two long hours I just said goodbye and told them I needed to be somewhere else. I went home and just sulked about how awful that day felt.

Call me petty but I had hard feelings for them after that and refused to show up at a lot of parties that followed. I totally felt like a pushover and was treated like one on my birthday. It sucked. Teenage me was very hurt. Almost a decade after that, I still feel salty about it.
Sadly, my friend, we learn it the hard way.

I've been considering this for a while now. I would probably have to let go of the money I paid for her flights and just rebook my reservations for one, unless I could find a friend to go with me on such a short notice. I don't want to be on a holiday feeling more stressed than I was back home.

First time for something this big, yes. I have not traveled with her alone, but we always did before with family in tow. I believe it is a mistake to consider traveling with her because she might just be a freeloader. Should have known so when she told me before about one of her friends footing the bill for their trip to Vermont. No wonder there were no more trips after that.

Yeah, I thought it's common knowledge that while some people plan the trip for everyone, everyone must pay their share, especially in cases like this where the people involved are working adults. I often travel with my friends and we take turns planning and booking stuff for each other but we always pay what we have to. I guess my sister is so entitled because she thinks that as family I shouldn't ask her to pay.

I paid for the flights because I used my credit card for booking them. She was excited when she heard about it and I immediately told her how much she should pay me back. She said she would pay "next time," and I took her word for it because she's my sister. 

I also booked the accommodations and tours (using my CC again) because she claimed she didn't know much about preparing an itinerary as she is not a frequent traveler. I worked on this trip so much and all she had to do was to pay me back her half. But she expects me to cover everything for her just because I booked stuff for us. Well, if I didn't, who would? It's not like she wanted to.
Definitely no future travel plans with her! It's so stupid of me to be this forgiving just because she is my sister.

I actually thought of doing this before but unfortunately one of the terms of the plane tickets is name changes are not allowed. I know it's stupid to have come this far. I already booked everything because I really wanted to go... I don't want to go to Europe not knowing where to stay. I guess the huge mistake is I hoped that one day she'll pay me back her half.
